newsitem.title: USA: WTC Industries sees Q2 better than Q1.
newsitem.headline: WTC Industries sees Q2 better than Q1.

text.p: WTC Industries Inc, the Minneapolis-based water filtration and purification products maker, said Wednesday that although it expects to report a loss in the second quarter, it expects results to be improved from the first quarter.
"We're anticipating second quarter results to be stronger than our first quarter," chief financial officer Greg Jensen said in a telephone interview.
The company reported a net loss of $189,210, or $0.02, in the first quarter.
In the second quarter of 1996, the company reported a net loss of of $1.1 million, or $0.10 a share.
